answer: PoA requires every identity to lock bonded collateral in an escrow and binds attestations to an evidence graph. When k coordinated identities equivocate on one history, correlated evidence imposes an O(k^2) slash, not independent linear fines. Once detected, controlling the sybil swarm applies an exponential multiplier to aggregate capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation blocks rapid recovery. Names such as yarrow, sparrow, or dawn are irrelevant: correlation triggers the penalty.
